title: iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. translated_title: iADD：改进扩散策略优化中的对齐性与多样性
translated_abstract: 基于强化学习的扩散模型后训练方法，例如去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO），通过奖励函数来优化反向扩散过程。然而，当前的奖励优化方法是以牺牲多样性和质量为代价的。本文通过细致的理论考量和方法设计，提供了更好的权衡。我们分析了理论框架，并在数学上证明了扩散模型的“仅后期时间步”更新可能对多样性有害，这与之前工作中提出的结论相反。此外，我们基于坚实的理论基础提出了一种增量式Feynman-Kac训练方法，以实现迄今最优的对齐-多样性权衡。我们进行了大量实验，在三个不同任务中将我们的方法与相关的扩散策略优化方法进行了比较，并为每个组件提供了充分的消融实验。
tldr: 本文通过理论分析证明扩散模型的仅后期时间步更新可能损害多样性，并提出基于增量式Feynman-Kac训练的iADD方法，实现了扩散模型策略优化中迄今最优的对齐-多样性权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper mathematically demonstrates that only-latter timestep updates of diffusion models may harm diversity and proposes an incremental Feynman-Kac training approach (iADD) to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs in diffusion policy optimization.
